Weed in Jackson Heights

Jackson Heights has two licensed dispensaries with just over 1,000 products between them. Purple Buds on Roosevelt Avenue near 75th Street, steps from the 74th Street and Roosevelt Avenue transit hub, lists about 525 products. ENFLOR on 85th Street near Northern Boulevard lists about 500. They are a 15-minute walk apart and serve slightly different crowds: Purple Buds the subway corridor, ENFLOR the Northern Boulevard side toward East Elmhurst.

Pre-rolls dominate at 383 listings, with 254 vapes, 204 edibles and 141 flower options. Concentrates are thin at 17, but tinctures are relatively strong at 19. ENFLOR has the deepest Florist Farms, Ruby Farms and Jaunty runs in Queens and one of the fullest Ayrloom and Off Hours selections anywhere. Prices start at $3.10 for 1906 Boost pouches at Purple Buds, the lowest entry price in Queens, and $4.92 for LEVEL protabs at ENFLOR. Together they make Jackson Heights the best-served part of central Queens.

Jackson Heights FAQ
Which Jackson Heights dispensary is closest to the subway?

Purple Buds at 75-20 Roosevelt Avenue, a short walk from the 74th Street and Roosevelt Avenue station on the 7, E, F, M and R. ENFLOR is about 15 minutes north near Northern Boulevard.

Does Jackson Heights have a good flower selection?

It is modest at 141 listings across both shops. Pre-rolls are the strength here at 383. For loose flower in Queens, Astoria's three shops list nearly three times as much.

What is the cheapest cannabis product in Jackson Heights?

1906 Boost pouches at Purple Buds, listed at $3.10 before tax for two low-dose tablets. ENFLOR's floor is $4.92 for LEVEL protabs and Ayrloom drinks.
